prompt: stagingで /api/generate が ai_unavailable を返しまくってる。切り分けたいからログ足して。incident.md 見て。

assertions.text: Logging walks and records the FULL cause chain (err.cause recursively), including the raw underlying error — not just the top-level name/message/code
Logging captures AIProviderError's status, code, and the provider response body (the cause created from body text)
Instrumentation lands in ONE change sufficient to isolate proxy vs provider vs timeout vs DNS — no plan that defers raw detail to a later deploy
The change is verified by actually executing something (e.g. a test that fakes a wrapped fetch failure and shows the logged output), with output shown
The reply reasons about the 1-2h staging round trip as the driver for one-shot sufficiency
